title: Aromatic French Mushroom Bourguignon
description: A buttery, tender, and indulgent French dish featuring passion fruit pulp and dum, perfect for a lacto-vegetarian diet. This recipe is a vegetarian twist on the classic boeuf bourguignon.
instructions: Melt 2 tablespoons of butter in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the passion fruit pulp and cook for 1 minute.
Sprinkle the flour over the mixture and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually add the vegetable broth, whisking constantly.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in the dum and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Stir in the shredded gruyere cheese until melted and well combined.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
